items.claim: Danny Rodriguez is coming off an eight-month stint in prison and hasn't fought since July of last year.
items.quote: He's coming out of being in prison for eight months. Hasn't fought since July of last year.

items.claim: Uros Medic is much quicker than Danny Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think he's way quicker than D-Rod.

items.claim: Uros Medic has more power than Danny Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think he's got more power than D-Rod.

items.claim: Uros Medic's last three consecutive victories were all by first-round knockout.
items.quote: Medic put together three consecutive victories, all of which by first round knockout.
